7531457.name: Trapped in a Lab
7531457.author: Balt Tlab
7531457.description: -VERSION 0.0.1 There is no screenshot because i kept disconnecting when i try to enter on Wegl I hope this little game will buy me some time to work on Avenger X games and other Foxyou72's games [Description] This game is obviously inspired from a game called "Half dead" but i was working on a different game inspired from it too. The game is called "Kidnapped" You are trapped in a maze with tons of rooms that look the same as eachother but with random traps and There is 10 flags in the maze, only one of them is open randomly each round However, the game was too similar to "Half dead" and laggy so i created something more original, it's this game -VERSION 0.0.2 +Little easier difficulty +2 more new floors +1 new trap +Alternate restart round -VERSION 0.0.3 +New screenshot (suggested by _UNKN0WN_) +Changed sky color +Added lights +Added parkour in spectate/waiting room +Fixed restart round (The door opens for 1s when a person gets health pack, heal ray in the lab and then that person waiting will get in the restart round and ruin the fun)
